description: Structured Pydantic schema for Startup Idea Analyzer output.

summary.description: Concise synthesis summary of the core startup proposal concept.
summary.title: Summary

startup_category.description: Primary industry vertical/category classification if identified.
startup_category.title: Startup Category

operational_pillars.description: Core operational/technical pillars required to build the startup.
operational_pillars.title: Operational Pillars

technical_feasibility_score.description: Feasibility score rating from 0 (impossible) to 100 (highly feasible).
technical_feasibility_score.title: Technical Feasibility Score

rationale.description: Detailed technical feasibility rationale and explanation.
rationale.title: Rationale

key_assumptions.description: Critical underlying assumptions that require market/tech validation.
key_assumptions.title: Key Assumptions

strengths.description: Key architectural, technical, or market strengths of the proposal.
strengths.title: Strengths

weaknesses.description: Potential operational, data, or technical weaknesses/risks.
weaknesses.title: Weaknesses

title: StartupIdeaAnalysis
